newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia 1996 passenger car sales up 22.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia 1996 passenger car sales up 22.5 pct.

text.p: Sales of passenger cars in Malaysia for 1996 rose by 22.5 percent to 275,615 units from a year earlier, the Malaysian Motor Traders Association said in its annual report on Thursday.
The trade group forecast passenger car sales to be up eight percent to 297,664 in 1997.

"Coupled with an outstanding year for the Malaysian economy, with a GDP (Gross Domestic Product) growth rate of 8.5 percent it is envisaged that sales will register a continued growth in 1997," Aishah Ahmad, chairman of the group said in the report.
Commercial vehicle sales in Malaysia rose by 47.0 percent to 69,444 units in 1996 from 1995, and are expected to grow by 23.0 percent to 85,680 units in 1997, the report said.
